mapper.select: SELECT s.scenario_no, s.category_no, c.name AS category_name, s.title, s.description, s.status, s.active_version_no, s.frst_reg_dt, s.lst_chg_dt FROM tb_scenario s JOIN tb_scenario_category c ON c.scenario_category_no = s.category_no WHERE s.scenario_no = #{id}

SELECT s.scenario_no, s.category_no, c.name AS category_name, s.title, s.description, s.status, s.active_version_no, s.frst_reg_dt, s.lst_chg_dt FROM tb_scenario s JOIN tb_scenario_category c ON c.scenario_category_no = s.category_no WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.active_version_no IS NOT NULL AND c.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY s.scenario_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_scenario (category_no, title, description, status) VALUES (#{categoryNo}, #{title}, #{description}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_scenario SET category_no = #{categoryNo}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, lst_chg_dt = now() WHERE scenario_no = #{scenarioNo}
UPDATE tb_scenario SET status = #{status}, lst_chg_dt = now() WHERE scenario_no = #{id}
UPDATE tb_scenario SET status = 'ACTIVE', active_version_no = #{activeVersionId}, lst_chg_dt = now() WHERE scenario_no = #{id}
